objectives.text: Read decimals by place value in the tenths and hundredths places
successCriteria: I can say what each digit in 0.25 is worth: 2 tenths and 5 hundredths
I can split one whole into ten tenths or one hundred hundredths
assessmentPoints: Tenths bar answers in the opening activity
Hundredths square answers in the second activity

objectives.text: Add decimals by matching place values first, writing 0.4 as 0.40
successCriteria: I can rewrite 0.4 as 0.40 before adding
I can work out 0.4 + 0.25 = 0.65 by lining up tenths under tenths and hundredths under hundredths
assessmentPoints: Guided addition answers in the third activity
Worksheet answers in the closing practice

objectives.text: Compare decimals by place value, not by digit count
successCriteria: I can explain why 0.4 covers more of the whole than 0.25
I can spot the digit-count trap and say what goes wrong
assessmentPoints: Responses when the trap is sprung in the fourth activity
Exit ticket answers on the comparison question

activities.title: Tenths: split the bar into ten equal parts

differentiation.support: Provide the addition written in a place-value grid so tenths and hundredths stay in their columns.

differentiation.stretch: Ask learners to compare 0.4 with 0.35 using the same matched-places method.
